page.overview:
Who is Clarabelle Clay?

is a firbolg living at the Blooming Grove and the sister of Caduceus Clay. Like most others in the Clay family, she left her home to find a way to protect it from the advancing corruption of the surrounding Savalirwood. She traveled alongside her brother Colton, and the pair were petrified at the Whitedawn Lagoon, where they remained until restored in 836 PD by Caduceus. She returned to the Grove with the rest of her family.

As an NPC, she is played by Matthew Mercer.

In 836 PD, she was in her mid-teens, bright-eyed with long stringy hair past her shoulders stained in a variety of different colors. She was described as the "unkempt wild kid of the family". Caduceus affectionately described her as weird.

Clarabelle lived in the Blooming Grove in the Savalirwood of the Greying Wildlands with the rest of the Clay family. She, like all in the family, is a worshiper of Melora and spends her time administering burial by interment. She left the Grove in 828 or 829 PD with her brother Colton to visit the temples at Kravaraad and the Whitedawn Lagoon in search of a way to stop the corruption of the Savalirwood from progressing into the Grove. She was petrified by a gorgon at the White Dawn Lagoon, where she remained for seven or eight years.
